_readme: Mapping for history[].content (docs/execution-plan.md §A). Same discipline as reference_type_map.json: nothing here is a guess. `source` says how each entry was established. Loader: src/legal_crawler/status_codes.py — fail-loud on anything absent.
_how_the_base_codes_were_established: The API states them itself. /doc/{id}'s effStatus object carries BOTH `code` and `name` (e.g. {code: 'HHL1P', name: 'Hết hiệu lực một phần'}), tallied across all 20,749 crawled documents. No UI scraping was needed, unlike referenceType. Cross-checked against the free-text history rows, which spell out the same transitions in words: 'CHL → HHL1P' appears alongside 'Hết hiệu lực một phần → Hết hiệu lực toàn bộ'.
_on_the_numeric_suffixes: HHL1P1/2/3/4 and TNHL1P are NOT resolved, and are deliberately not guessed. What is known: (1) vbpl.vn's own frontend never renders these codes — the string 'HHL1P' appears nowhere in its JS bundle, so there is no displayed label to verify against; (2) 100% of suffixed rows have sourceDocumentName=null and createdBy=Admin, while bare HHL1P is 79% sourced and usually written by Job; (3) statistically HHL1P1 co-occurs with inbound 'bãi bỏ' edges (75%) and HHL1P3 with 'sửa đổi bổ sung' (85%) — correlation only, on documents having exactly one affecting relation; (4) the suffix does not encode provision level: all variants mix Khoản/Điều/Điểm alike. The frontend does draw a partial-vs-total distinction, but from a DIFFERENT field, `effectAllType`, on relation objects (ABROGATES with effectAllType in [1,3] renders as 'Bãi bỏ một phần', in [0,2,null] as 'Bãi bỏ toàn bộ'; REPLACES inverts the null case). That field is not exposed by any endpoint reachable without auth — not in references[], not in /diagram, not in any of the 7 server actions probed. CONSEQUENCE FOR STAGE 6: rely on the prefix, which is unambiguous, and keep the raw code verbatim. Do not attach legal meaning to the digit.

CHL.note: 7,102 documents carry this as their current effStatus.

HHL1P.note: 1,899 documents. Bare form is usually written by Job and names its source document.

HHL1P1.note: Prefix verified; suffix meaning unknown — see _on_the_numeric_suffixes. Correlates with inbound 'bãi bỏ' edges (75%), NOT treated as evidence.

HHL1P2.note: Prefix verified; suffix meaning unknown. Rare (17 documents).

HHL1P3.note: Prefix verified; suffix meaning unknown. Most common suffixed form. Correlates with inbound 'sửa đổi bổ sung' edges (85%), NOT treated as evidence.

HHL1P4.note: Prefix verified; suffix meaning unknown. Rare (67 documents).

TNHL1P.note: TNHL verified from the API; '1P' reads as một phần by the same construction as HHL1P, and the frontend's status-colour switch does list 'ngưng hiệu lực một phần' as a rendered state.

DATE_BH.note: On Job-written rows the createdDate matches the document's own issueDate. Admin-written DATE_BH rows carry the data-entry timestamp instead and must be ignored — see is_legal_date.

DATE_HL.note: Job-written rows match the document's effFrom (occasionally off by one day; history is the event, effFrom the summary).

DATE_HHL.note: Job-written rows match the document's effTo.
